2026_01_GB_MIN.headline: Green Bay’s changing front faces a Minnesota offense built to stress protection rules
2026_01_GB_MIN.paragraph1: Green Bay enters with uncertainty along the offensive line and without Josh Jacobs, while Minnesota opens the Kyler Murray era in Kevin O’Connell’s offense. The Packers may need Jordan Love to carry more of the early-down burden, especially if the run game lacks its usual anchor. Minnesota’s defense can exploit protection communication with pressure looks, but the Vikings also have to contain Green Bay’s receiving speed and avoid giving Love clean vertical windows when coverage rotates late.
2026_01_GB_MIN.model_rationale: Minnesota can pressure Green Bay’s changing protection structure, while the Packers’ counter is to let Love attack quickly and prevent the Vikings from turning obvious passing downs into their preferred game.
